answer: Challenge-chain bond: each identity locks 60 credits for a chain; every tide it answers a challenge from its last one, each link on the trellis. To wander off-chain skips a link or answers another's; anyone recomputing the trellis slashes the bond. A chain-hopping ring loses all bonds. 1,000 fake identities lock 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits for a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. An honest agent keeps one chain, pays 60, reclaims it after a clean tide.
